description: Precise edits by words, as a person asks a designer: «move the logo to the top right» → { do: «move», target: { role: «logo» }, to: «top-right» }; «make the title 20% bigger» → { do: «resize», target: { role: «headline» }, percent: 20 }; «use our brand blue for the button» → { do: «colour», target: { role: «button» }, colour: «brand blue» }; «put the date under the title» → { do: «place», target: { role: «date» }, relation: «under», with: { role: «headline» } }; «make the second slide like the first» → { do: «match», from_slide: 1, to_slide: 2 }. More examples: describe_catalogue { what: "edits" } (or paletoo://guide/adjust). All the edits of one request in ONE call: one change (one undo step, one version), all or nothing. When a target fits several things nothing changes and a question comes back — never guess: ask the person, then call again with slide, where, nth or id. Live in the person’s open editor (your cursor visits each target), else saved as a new version. A look (effect) needs the design open. Nothing is deleted.

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

edits.description: every edit of one request: { do, target, and the fields of that do }; e.g. [{ "do": "move", "target": { "role": "logo" }, "to": "top-right" }]

by.description: move: by so much, x right, y down, unit px (default) or %; e.g. { "x": 40, "y": 0 }

colour.description: colour: a hex (#1c7ed6), a colour word (en / uk / pl), «brand», «brand blue», a colour of the design («accent», a style’s name), «darker» / «lighter»

do.description: move, align, distribute, resize, order (layer order), colour, type (typography), radius, stroke, shadow, opacity, swap, place (next to another), match (one slide like another), effect (a look)

gap.description: place: px between them (default: from their sizes)

height.description: resize: to this height in px

look.description: effect: a look of Paletoo’s (needs the design open); e.g. «risograph» (the looks: describe_catalogue effects)

part.description: colour of a group (the button): its fill (default) or its text

radius.description: radius: px or none, small, medium, large, pill

stroke_width.description: stroke: px or none, thin, medium, thick

target.description: what to change, as the person named it: a role, its words, a position, the slide — or an id from describe_design. Several matches without all: true → nothing changes, a question comes back; e.g. { "role": "logo" }

id.description: a layer or group id from describe_design

nth.description: in reading order, or by size

role.description: text = any, background = the slide’s colour, everything = all on it

text.description: words written in it; e.g. «Grand opening»

where.description: where it is now on its slide

words.description: the person’s own words for it (en / uk / pl); e.g. «заголовок на другому слайді»

to.description: move: where on its slide (inside the design’s own margin)

together.description: move: several things as one block (default true)

weight.description: type: 100–900 or thin, light, regular, medium, bold, black, bolder, lighter

width.description: resize: to this width in px (proportions kept)

with.description: swap / place: the other thing, named as target is; e.g. { "role": "headline" }

within.description: align: to the slide’s margin (default) or to each other

say.description: optional: what your cursor says in the editor, in the person’s language («Двигаю логотип»); default from the edits

name: adjust_design
title: Adjust precisely
